m.chalisa.do1: Victory, victory to Śrī Mahālakṣmī; Mother, I meditate on you. Accomplish my works, knowing me as your own child and servant.
m.chalisa.cau1: Salutation to Mahālakṣmī; victory to the Mother. Your name is famed in the world.
m.chalisa.cau2: Mother Bhavānī, you are the primal Śakti; all men, sages and the wise worship you.
m.chalisa.cau3: You sustain the world and bring every happiness; for the good of your own people you fill the storehouses.
m.chalisa.cau4: Your seat is on the petals of a white lotus; Mother, you shine on your lotus throne.
m.chalisa.cau5: Your garments are white and your ornaments white; you are adorned with flowers, white upon white.
m.chalisa.cau6: A royal umbrella is over your head, and your form is most majestic; a garland of pearls shines at your neck.
m.chalisa.cau7: Your curling hair is beautiful; your eyes are pure, and your attire is beyond compare.
m.chalisa.cau8: Your four arms are like lotus stalks; they bring good and joy to gods, men and sages.
m.chalisa.cau9: Mother, the beauty of your speech is wondrous; you have made the whole world a mine of joy.
m.chalisa.cau10: Bhavānī, your nature is peaceful and gentle; you are the mine of joy for the whole world.
m.chalisa.cau11: Mahālakṣmī, Mother, you are blessed; you made the creation from the five elements.
m.chalisa.cau12: You brought forth all beings, moving and unmoving; you made beasts and birds, men and women.
m.chalisa.cau13: On the face of the earth you made countless trees grow, and lovely fruits and flowers of countless colours.
m.chalisa.cau14: Seeing your beauty, gods and sages, men and women ever cry victory to you.
m.chalisa.cau15: Indra, lord of the gods, and all kings meditate on you and bow their heads before you.
m.chalisa.cau16: All four Vedas have sung your fame, but they have not found the end of your unfathomable glory.
m.chalisa.cau17: Mother, the one to whom you show mercy is the one the world calls blessed.
m.chalisa.cau18: In a moment you make a king a pauper, and you make no delay in making a pauper a king.
m.chalisa.cau19: Mother, those in whose homes you dwell have their fame shine out across the world.
m.chalisa.cau20: Whoever meditates on you finds much happiness; whoever stays turned away suffers sorrow.
m.chalisa.cau21: Mahālakṣmī, giver of joy to your people, I meditate on you, bowing my head.
m.chalisa.cau22: Knowing me as one of your own, take me as your own; give happiness and wealth and destroy sorrow.
m.chalisa.cau23: Om śrī śrī, mine of victory and joy; Mother, knowing me as one of your own, give me Ṛddhi and Siddhi, prosperity and attainment.
m.chalisa.cau24: Om hrīṃ, Om hrīṃ, remove all illness; turn your pure gaze on your people.
m.chalisa.cau25: Om klīṃ, Om klīṃ, destroy the enemies; Mother, for the good of your people grant the boon of fearlessness.
m.chalisa.cau26: Om, victory, victory, victory to the Mother; you bring all the works of your devotees to completion.
m.chalisa.cau27: Om, salutation, salutation to you who carry us across the ocean of existence; you are the boat that brings us across, out of the whirlpool.
m.chalisa.cau28: Mother, hear this plea of ours: fulfil our hopes, and do it now.
m.chalisa.cau29: Whoever in debt or in sorrow meditates on you, that person gains happiness and wealth.
m.chalisa.cau30: Whoever is stricken with disease and meditates on you, his body is made pure.
m.chalisa.cau31: Victory, victory to the great queen, beloved of Viṣṇu; your boundless glory cannot be told.
m.chalisa.cau32: One without a son who meditates on you gains a son and rejoices greatly.
m.chalisa.cau33: Protect me, protect me; I have come to you for refuge. Mother, make not the least delay now.
m.chalisa.cau34: Come, Mother, do not delay; grant your devotee the boon of your dwelling in his heart.
m.chalisa.cau35: I do not know the secret of japa or austerity; become the boatman and take me across the ocean of worldly existence.
m.chalisa.cau36: Again and again I pray with folded hands; now fulfil my hope.
m.chalisa.cau37: Knowing me your servant, turn my hardships away; rescue me from every disease.
m.chalisa.cau38: Whoever keeps you in remembrance with devoted love wins fair fame and greatness in the world.
m.chalisa.cau39: Your fame has spread over the world; Śeṣa and Śiva do not find its end.
m.chalisa.cau40: Govinda is in your refuge night and day; fulfil our longing.
m.chalisa.do2: Whoever reads and hears the Mahālakṣmī Chālīsā with mind intent now gains the goals of life; so the Vedas sing and declare.
